scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and supplemental deterministic/exact-arithmetic checks; established covariance and spectral-filter formulas attributed to their sources; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional, full-column-rank linear inverse problems with white Gaussian noise and fixed-step Landweber starting at zero.
Best rank-restricted covariance approximation refers to exact eigen-subspace selection; no guarantee is made for approximate randomized subspaces.
The unbounded error/probe-variance ratio requires an even iteration count and a near-upper-stability step; rank inversion can occur at nonovershooting steps.
Probe variance is for the standard independent Rademacher diagonal estimator, not total confidence-interval coverage.
Historical priority cannot be established by incomplete literature access; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp covariance-rank frontier for finite-step Landweber iteration
